context: Tests whether the agent correctly integrates gitleaks secret scanning into a private GitHub repository that lacks a GITLEAKS_LICENSE. Covers hook placement (pre-commit not pre-push), the CLI-based CI approach with proper diff-scoping, safe SHA handling, zero-SHA edge cases, and ensuring the scan actually gates the build and deploy jobs.

checklist.name: Gitleaks in pre-commit
checklist.description: `.githooks/pre-commit` contains a `gitleaks protect --staged` invocation (or equivalent staged-only scan)

checklist.name: Existing verify call preserved
checklist.description: `.githooks/pre-commit` still contains the original `pnpm verify` call from inputs/ — the task says to extend the existing hooks, not replace them, so removing it (even while adding gitleaks) is a regression

checklist.name: CI uses CLI not action
checklist.description: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` does NOT use `gitleaks/gitleaks-action`; instead downloads and runs the gitleaks CLI binary directly

checklist.name: Full history checkout
checklist.description: The CI checkout step in the gitleaks scan job uses `fetch-depth: 0`

checklist.name: SHAs via env block
checklist.description: The CI scan step passes `github.event.before` and `github.sha` (or equivalent SHAs) via the `env:` block — these values do NOT appear as `${{ }}` interpolations directly inside the `run:` script body

checklist.name: Zero-SHA fallback
checklist.description: The CI scan step explicitly checks whether the before-SHA is all zeros (or empty) and falls back to scanning only the last commit in that case

checklist.name: Diff-scoped CI scan
checklist.description: The CI scan uses a commit range (`--log-opts` with a SHA range such as `BEFORE..HEAD`) rather than a full-history bare scan (e.g., `gitleaks git .` with no scope restriction)

checklist.name: Scan gates build and deploy
checklist.description: Both the `build` job and the `deploy` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` declare a `needs:` dependency on the gitleaks scan job

checklist.name: Baseline path in SCANNING.md
checklist.description: `SCANNING.md` mentions the `--baseline-path` flag and explains its role in suppressing confirmed-innocuous findings from a first-time full-history scan

checklist.name: Hook placement rationale
checklist.description: `SCANNING.md` explains why gitleaks belongs in `pre-commit` rather than `pre-push`

checklist.name: Versioned download URL
checklist.description: The CI step that downloads gitleaks uses a specific version number in the URL (e.g., `v8.30.1` or another pinned version), not an unversioned or `latest` URL
